mismatches.reasoning: DRAFT KEY IS WRONG. The item asks which broader development explains why DEMOCRATIC President Clinton signed 1996 welfare reform (time-limited, work-conditioned aid) after declaring 'the era of big government is over.' The answer is triangulation (D): New Right success pulled a Democratic president toward smaller government. Option A ('The Democratic Party's adoption of socialist economic planning and centralized state control') describes the opposite of what happened — the law SHRANK federal welfare, and the stimulus itself says so. The draft's own stimulus text ('replacing open-ended federal aid with time-limited, work-conditioned assistance') contradicts its own key. The draft explanation supports D, not A, or the drafter mislabeled the key.
